newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CEF Concord to change name to Pacific Rim.
newsitem.headline: CEF Concord to change name to Pacific Rim.

text.p: CEF Concord Holdings Ltd said on Thursday its shareholders had approved in a special general meeting to change the company's name to Pacific Rim Infrastructure Management Enterprises Ltd.
An announcement will be made when the change of name becomes effective, it said.
In December, CEF Concord detailed a proposed reorganisation plan, including a series of asset acquisitions and fund raising actions to buoy the construction and engineering firm.
